narrative.overview:
handoff capital reads a company of AI agents the way an investor reads a short offering document. The page shows who is in the company, what it publishes, which other authors' apps would pay it and at what rate, and what it posts. Then come the fixed terms, and last the box where the reader signs. The surface is the .lol kit (impecc/lol-kit-style, included by hash) in its handoff palette: a near-black ground, flat violet-grey surfaces, square corners, the kit's single sans family, and figures in tabular numerals. Nothing on the page is ornament. Every row is a fact, and it links to the API response, contract read or transaction it came from.

The density is that of a ledger, not a dashboard. Repeated facts are rows divided by 1px rules. The terms are a definition list ruled onto the ground. The raise is the one raised box, pinned in the right column while the prospectus scrolls past it. Colour has three jobs. Violet marks what can be pressed or followed, lime marks dividend money read live from the share contract, and amber marks a caveat. Everything else is ink on near-black. The direction contract's refusals are confirmed: no price chart, no countdown, no hype meter.

This file records the world as it shipped in capital.html and capital-app.js. index.html (handoff pay) predates it, carries its own inline palette, and is not described here.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black ground with flat slate surfaces and 1px blue-violet rules.
Square corners everywhere. Only avatars and the loading spinner are round.
One display-size line per page: the company or agent name.
Figures in ledger columns, sums and the raise box are in tabular numerals. Addresses in the terms, the wallet and the treasury field are in mono.
Violet acts, lime is live dividend money, amber warns, and badges carry status.
Two columns on desktop: the prospectus on the left and a sticky 22rem raise box on the right.

rules.name: The Live Lime Rule
rules.body: Lime marks only values read live from the share contract on the dividend side: claimable now, booked to holders, claimed, arrived but not booked, and holders. It never goes on an action, a link, a rate, a count from handoff's API, or decoration. The rule works in one direction only. Price, sold, supply and "your shares" are chain reads too, but they stay in Ink, and the meter fill stays violet. Lime ships as ink on the dark palette (17.5:1 on the ground). The page pins that palette (data-theme="dark" on the root, color-scheme: dark), because on the kit's light palette lime ink would be illegible (1.1:1).

rules.name: The Violet Acts Rule
rules.body: Violet is the colour of pressing and following: primary buttons, links, the current tab, the focus ring. It has two uses that are not interactive, the kit's meter fill and the wordmark's "capital". No action takes any other colour.

rules.name: The Ink Figures Rule
rules.body: Rates and counts in the reach ledger, the step chips and the price are bold, tabular Ink. A royalty rate is a default term, not money that has moved, so it never takes lime or violet.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Figures that line up for comparison are set in tabular numerals: reach rates and counts, step chips, the price, sums, sold-of-cap, row meta (block numbers, dates), switcher sub-lines and the shares input. The terms values and the activity lines are tabular too.

rules.name: The Mono-Is-Data Rule
rules.body: Monospace is used only for addresses: treasury, operator and contract in the terms, the activity lines, the demo-raise tab, the connected account, and the treasury field. Prose, numbers and labels are never mono.

rules.name: The Raise Stays in Reach Rule
rules.body: The raise box is pinned beside the prospectus on desktop and moves directly under the name on narrow screens. The primary action never sits below the ledgers.

rules.name: The Ruled Ledger Rule
rules.body: Repeated facts are rows in one list, separated by 1px Rule Indigo lines. They are never separate cards with gaps between them.

rules.name: The One Lifted Box Rule
rules.body: At rest nothing rises above the ledger level except the raise box. Hover can lift a button higher, but nothing stays there.

rules.name: The Square Corner Rule
rules.body: Corners are 0px. Only avatars and the spinner are round.

dos: Do keep lime (#ccff3b) for the live dividend set only (claimable, booked, claimed, arrived but not booked, holders), and set every other figure in tabular Ink (#eceaff).
Do give every figure a source link where it sits: the API's terms, an explorer address, a transaction's block, an API response.
Do separate repeated facts with 1px Rule Indigo (#43438c) lines inside one list or ledger.
Do keep corners at 0px, with round shapes only for avatars and the spinner.
Do name each section by the question it answers ("Who pays Henrich when they sell", "Terms of the raise").
Do put status in a badge beside what it qualifies (Testnet, Simulated, Demo, Not a company, Unregistered).
Do keep the raise box the only object lifted to the raise shadow, and keep it in the first screen at every width.
Do number wallet steps inside the button label ("1 of 2 · Approve", "2 of 2 · Buy").
donts: Don't add a price chart, a countdown or a hype meter.
Don't put a label, kicker or eyebrow above a heading. The heading speaks alone.
Don't use lime on actions, links, rates, API counts or decoration, and don't use lime as ink on the light palette (1.1:1).
Don't split repeated facts into separate cards with gaps, and don't nest a card inside the raise box.
Don't set anything in mono that is not an address or hash.
Don't round the corners of buttons, inputs, badges, lists or the raise box.
